content.name: Callum McLeod
content.title: Talent Acquisition Partner
content.summary: Recruiter with nine years across agency and in-house roles, specialising in software and data hiring. Hires engineers for a 600-person fintech, cut average time to hire from 52 to 34 days, and raised the share of women in engineering offers from 18% to 31%.

experience.title: Talent Acquisition Partner
bullets: Own engineering and data hiring for a 600-person fintech, closing 45 to 55 roles a year.
Reduced average time to hire from 52 to 34 days by agreeing interview SLAs with hiring managers and moving to structured scorecards.
Raised the share of offers to women in engineering from 18% to 31% through rewritten adverts and diverse interview panels.
Brought agency spend down by £240k a year by building a direct-sourcing and referral pipeline.

experience.title: Senior Recruitment Consultant
bullets: Billed £310k in my best year placing developers and data engineers with Scottish tech firms.
Managed 14 retained and contingent clients, including three exclusive accounts I won.
Trained four new consultants on candidate qualification and client calls.

experience.title: Trainee Recruitment Consultant
bullets: Recruited for contract and permanent IT support roles across the central belt.
Made 60 to 80 candidate and client calls a day and hit target in seven of eight quarters.

achievements.title: Time to hire down to 34 days
achievements.detail: Interview SLAs and scorecards at Clydeway Payments.

achievements.title: Top biller 2021
achievements.detail: Highest fee income in a team of 12 at Merchant City Talent.
